feed.title: pacs008 scheme changes
feed.subtitle: Dated ISO 20022 scheme rule changes for CBPR+, CHAPS and related profiles

entry.title: CBPR-ADDR-001 — Fully unstructured postal address is not accepted
entry.summary: From 14 November 2026 a fully unstructured postal address is rejected in CBPR+ payment messages.

entry.title: CBPR-ADDR-002 — Town Name is mandatory in a structured element
entry.summary: Town Name must be carried in TwnNm, not in an address line.

entry.title: CBPR-ADDR-003 — Country is mandatory as a two-letter ISO 3166 code
entry.summary: Country must be carried in Ctry as a two-letter ISO 3166 alpha-2 code.

entry.title: CBPR-ADDR-004 — Hybrid postal address is accepted
entry.summary: A hybrid address — structured Town Name and Country alongside address lines — is accepted, both before and after the November 2026 change.

entry.title: CBPR-ADDR-005 — Agent identified by BIC only is exempt
entry.summary: For agent fields, BIC-only identification remains valid; no postal address is required.

entry.title: CBPR-ADDR-006 — Message types excepted from the address requirement
entry.summary: The structured address requirement does not apply to admi.024, camt.025, camt.052, camt.053, camt.054 and camt.060.

entry.title: CHAPS-ADDR-001 — CHAPS validation library rejects fully unstructured addresses
entry.summary: From November 2026 the CHAPS validation library rejects payments carrying a fully unstructured address. Hybrid is the minimum acceptable form.

entry.title: CHAPS-PURP-001 — Purpose codes become mandatory on all CHAPS payments
entry.summary: From November 2027 the Bank of England requires a purpose code on all CHAPS payments, extending the earlier property and FI-to-FI requirement.

entry.title: CHAPS-RMT-001 — Structured remittance information becomes mandatory for CHAPS
entry.summary: From November 2027 remittance information carried in CHAPS payments must be structured.
